title: Component Part 2.6: functional NumericStepper + ProgressBar (next standard controls)
description:
DONE (Part 2.6). Implemented mx.controls.NumericStepper + mx.controls.ProgressBar on the registry-driven framework (packages/swf/src/compiler/components.ts) — registry entries + authorClassBody only, reusing shared skin/class/registerClass/setComponentParam infra.

NumericStepper: input-box face + value field (label_txt, width reduced by STEPPER_BTN_WIDTH) + up_mk/down_mk arrow marks. Honors author value/minimum/maximum/stepSize; clamps to [min,max]; up-half click stepUp(+stepSize), down-half stepDown; getValue/setValue/stepUp/stepDown + change broadcast; overridden setComponentParam re-clamps live.
ProgressBar: grey track face + fill_mk bar scaled via _xscale to value/maximum (clamped 0..100%); runtime value/maximum default 0/100 (NO value/maximum catalog param — driven via setProgress/setValue/setMaximum, Flash manual mode); honors direction param; getValue/getMaximum/getPercentComplete.

VERIFICATION:
- Structural unit tests: packages/swf/src/__tests__/component-place.test.ts (57 tests pass; +10 new). Each control emits ExportAssets(FQ class), class DoInitAction (DefineFunction2) BEFORE registerClass, and the skin shapes (NumericStepper=3 shapes track+up+down +1 EditText; ProgressBar=2 shapes track+fill +1 EditText). Source assertions pin clamp/step/getValue-setValue and _xscale fill/setProgress/direction. Command: npx vitest run src/__tests__/component-place.test.ts → 57 passed.
- Full swf suite: pnpm --filter @flash/swf run test → 1457 passed (115 files).
- Ruffle ORACLE: apps/desktop/e2e/component-oracle.spec.ts (17 pass; +2 new). NumericStepper UP-button click increments value RED->BLUE (before red=20000 blue=32 -> after red=0 blue=20000). ProgressBar setProgress(80,100) -> getPercentComplete()>=75 RED->BLUE (after red=0 blue=20000). Both verified in real bundled Ruffle. Render counted-pixel oracle omitted (z-indexed headless wgpu-webgl returns blank capture for small skin; static skin covered structurally) — behavioral RED->BLUE is the acceptance truth. Keyboard entry into the stepper field is structural-only (headless Ruffle cannot type into a field); value changed via arrows/setValue.
- authoring-ui: 765 passed. core: 5323 passed, 2 failing FLA-fixture tests (carchive-validate/contents-structure/empty-bytematch) due to missing git-ignored fixtures/flash8-empty.fla — pre-existing task-1207 fixture absence, unrelated to this change (src/fla/, not src/compiler/).
- typecheck: tsc -p packages/swf/tsconfig.json clean; full package build green.
docs/13-components.md updated (Part 2.6 section). STILL GATED (not built): DataGrid/Tree/DateChooser/Accordion/Menu/ScrollPane/containers/data-binding.
